series.title: Nonfarm Business Sector: Labor Productivity (Output per Hour) for All Workers
series.definition: Nonfarm business real output per hour of all workers; observed labor productivity, not an AI contribution.

series.title: Nonfarm Business Sector: Unit Labor Costs for All Workers
series.definition: Nonfarm business nominal labor compensation per unit of real output.

series.title: Nonfarm Business Sector: Hourly Compensation for All Workers
series.definition: Nonfarm business nominal hourly compensation, including wages and benefits; same sector as OPHNFB and ULCNFB.

series.title: Real Private Nonresidential Fixed Investment
series.definition: Real private nonresidential fixed investment; broad business investment, not AI-only spending.

series.title: Private fixed investment in information processing equipment and software
series.definition: Nominal private fixed investment in information processing equipment and software; AI investment proxy, includes non-AI technology.

series.title: Private fixed investment: Nonresidential: Intellectual property products: Software
series.definition: Nominal private nonresidential software investment; AI investment proxy, not a direct AI-spending measure.

series.title: Private fixed investment: Nonresidential: Information processing equipment and software: Computers and peripheral equipment
series.definition: Nominal private investment in computers and peripheral equipment; includes non-AI uses.

series.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (US)
series.title: Industrial Production: Utilities: Commercial and Other Electricity Sales (NAICS = 22112pt.)
series.definition: Commercial and other electricity sales volume index. Demand proxy, not national kWh consumption or AI-specific load.

series.title: Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers: Electricity in U.S. City Average
series.definition: U.S. city average consumer electricity price index; not industrial tariffs or data-center electricity costs.

series.title: Real Gross Domestic Product
series.definition: Observed real U.S. GDP at seasonally adjusted annual rate; not potential GDP.

series.title: Employment Level
series.definition: Civilian employed persons age 16 and older, household survey. Population-control breaks are not adjusted by this site.

series.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (US)
series.title: Industrial Production: Manufacturing: Durable Goods: Semiconductor and Other Electronic Component (NAICS = 3344)
series.definition: Real production of semiconductors and other electronic components, NAICS 3344; broader than AI chips, not installed compute capacity.

series.title: Henry Hub Natural Gas Spot Price
series.definition: Henry Hub natural gas spot price; a generation-input benchmark, not an electricity tariff or a measure of AI demand.

series.title: Data center
series.definition: Private data-center construction spending, including non-AI data centers. Buildings put in place, not total AI capex, equipment purchases or installed computing capacity.
